input.command:
rustc /app/polyglot/main.rs && g++ -x c++ /app/polyglot/main.rs -o /app/polyglot/cmain && python3 -c '
import subprocess

def fib(n):
    a, b = 1, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return str(a)

for n in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 50, 85, 86, 87, 92, 93, 94, 100, 185, 186, 500, 1000, 5000]:
    expected = fib(n) + "\n"
    r_out = subprocess.check_output(["/app/polyglot/main", str(n)]).decode()
    c_out = subprocess.check_output(["/app/polyglot/cmain", str(n)]).decode()
    assert r_out == expected, f"Rust mismatch at {n}: {r_out!r} != {expected!r}"
    assert c_out == expected, f"C++ mismatch at {n}: {c_out!r} != {expected!r}"

print("All assertions passed! f(0..5):", [fib(i) for i in range(6)])
' && rm -f /app/polyglot/main /app/polyglot/cmain
